verdict.rationale: Secureframe's first-party framework pages cover HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001. CMMC and NIST 800-171 also appear on the same compliance platform. Each supported framework is described as getting control mapping and automated evidence-backed testing from shared integrations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and detail beyond marketing taglines on HIPAA/GDPR/PCI depth (e.g. cross-framework control reuse specifics).
